title: Fix ES module directory import errors in @object-ui/core
body:
CI failing on coverage step: ES modules don't support directory imports, but TypeScript wildcard type exports were compiling to `export * from './types'` (directory path without file extension).

## Changes

**packages/core/src/index.ts**
- Replace wildcard type export with explicit named exports:
  ```typescript
  // Before: compiles to directory import
  export type * from './types/index.js';
  
  // After: explicit named exports
  export type { SchemaNode, ComponentRendererProps } from './types/index.js';
  ```

**packages/core/src/validation/index.ts**
- Add file extension to avoid directory import:
  ```typescript
  // Before
  export * from './validators';
  
  // After
  export * from './validators/index.js';
  ```

**package.json**
- Add `pretest:coverage` script to ensure packages build before coverage runs (aligns with existing `pretest` behavior)
